✦ Ascendant Creed

Her signature moment: the war cry she delivers hovering off the ground.
  • She leaves the ground. Four frames of gathering, then Catherine lifts into the light — and settles back down across the final four frames.
  • The front line gains both. +30% ATK and +30% DEF for 3 turns, to every ally standing in a front hex.
  • She blesses herself too. Catherine belongs up front, so her own creed includes her.
  • The engine tracks her real altitude, so her shadow shrinks beneath her as she rises.
Lift · hang · descend

✦ Kit

One attack, one triage heal, one front-line blessing — plus a ward that answers every heal in the party.
Skill 1 · no cooldown

Reverent Strike

Single target · 120% ATK

A full swing of the flail at one enemy.

Skill 2 · 3-turn cooldown

Consecrated Mercy

Herself + 2 allies · 30% ATK each

Heals Catherine and the 2 most-wounded allies — picked by lowest HP percentage, so the healing always finds who needs it.

Skill 3 · 5-turn cooldown

Ascendant Creed

Front line · +30% ATK and +30% DEF

Rises into the light and blesses every front-hex ally for 3 turns.

Passive

Vow of Reverence

Any ally restored to health is shielded: +12% DEF for 2 turns. One ward at a time — it won't stack off repeated ticks.

Position bonus · front hex

Shieldbearer

While placed in a front hex, Catherine gains +18% DEF.
